pages.text: An Advanced Beehive is full at $(l)8 combs$() (honey level 5). Shears give the combs, a glass bottle gives a honey bottle.$(br2)Use a $(l:tools/smokers)smoker$(/l) on the hive first so the bees stay calm, or put a $(l:tools/chute)comb chute$(/l) under it to harvest it for you.
A bee that comes home to a full hive loses its comb, rare combs too, so harvest often.
